name: X
summary: Social network formerly known as Twitter.

flows.title: Write a post
steps: Type your post, up to 280 characters, into the compose box at the top of your Home timeline, or select the Post button in the navigation bar.
You can include up to 4 photos, a GIF, or a video in your post.
To schedule the post for a later date and time, select the calendar icon at the bottom of the compose box, make your schedule selections, then select Confirm.
Select the Post button to post it to your profile.
To save a draft instead, select the X icon in the top left corner of the compose box, then select Save.

flows.title: Delete a post
steps: Locate the post you want to delete.
Click the icon on the post that opens its menu.
